name: Virtual list lens dial turns Misread into Read correctly and back

planSteps.description: Open the site's chart page (the base URL, hash #/) and wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
In the lens bar at the bottom, verify the Virtual list dial ('List positions and a jump field') shows Off and its reading line says 'Misread'
Click the 'List positions and a jump field' lens dial
Verify the dial's reading line now says 'Misread → Read correctly' and the reading summary begins 'With 1 lens on.'
Click the 'List positions and a jump field' lens dial again
Verify the dial's reading line says 'Misread' again and the reading summary no longer mentions a lens
